summary.en-US: Adds a Slack-logo button to GitHub pull requests that copies a Slack-ready link: an emoji prefix, then the PR title (with number) hyperlinked to the PR. Paste into Slack and get a clean clickable link instead of a bare URL.

description.en-US: Sharing a GitHub pull request in Slack usually means pasting a bare URL. This extension adds a small Slack-logo button next to the title of every GitHub pull request (and a copy button on the PR list). One click copies the PR to your clipboard as rich text: :opened: PR title #123 (hyperlinked to the PR) Paste it into Slack and you get the emoji followed by the PR title as a clickable link. A plain-text fallback (title + URL) is included for editors that don't accept rich text. Settings Click the toolbar icon to change the message prefix. It defaults to the :opened: Slack emoji shortcode; use any shortcode (e.g. :rocket:) or leave it blank. Privacy Runs only on github.com pull request pages. No data is collected or sent anywhere; your prefix setting is stored with browser sync storage. Source code: https://github.com/balazsorban44/slack-copy-pr-link

version.approval_notes: Plain, unminified source; the shipped files are identical to shared/ in the GitHub repo (https://github.com/balazsorban44/slack-copy-pr-link, assembled by scripts/build.sh). The four innerHTML assignments in content.js set static SVG string constants only (ICON_SVG, ICON_OK, ICON_FAIL), never user or page data. No remote code, no network requests.
